name: Model Evaluation, Cross-Validation & Diagnostics
description: Rigorous validation strategies (K-Fold, Stratified, TimeSeriesSplit), classification & regression metrics, ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall curves, probability calibration, bias-variance tradeoff, and data leakage diagnostics.

subskills.name: Cross-Validation Strategies & Leakage Prevention
subskills.description: K-Fold, StratifiedKFold, GroupKFold, TimeSeriesSplit, Purged/Embargoed CV for financial/temporal data, and preventing train-test data leakage.

subskills.name: Classification Metrics (ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, F1, Log-Loss)
subskills.description: Confusion matrix, Precision, Recall, Specificity, F1-Score, F-beta, ROC Curve & AUC, Precision-Recall Curve & Average Precision, and Log-Loss.

subskills.name: Regression Metrics & Residual Diagnostics
subskills.description: MSE, RMSE, MAE, MAPE, SMAPE, R-squared (R2), Adjusted R2, homoscedasticity vs heteroscedasticity, and residual Q-Q plots.

subskills.name: Probability Calibration (Platt Scaling, Isotonic Regression)
subskills.description: Calibration curves / reliability diagrams, Brier score, Platt scaling (logistic calibration), and non-parametric Isotonic Regression.

subskills.name: Bias-Variance Tradeoff & Learning Curves
subskills.description: Decomposing error into bias, variance, and irreducible noise, plotting learning curves to diagnose underfitting vs overfitting.

subskills.name: Imbalanced Learning (SMOTE, Class Weights, Focal Loss)
subskills.description: Random oversampling/undersampling, SMOTE (Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique), ADASYN, class_weight='balanced', and cost-sensitive learning.

subskills.name: Decision Threshold Tuning & Cost-Benefit Matrices
subskills.description: Selecting optimal classification thresholds based on business cost matrices (cost of False Positive vs False Negative) rather than default 0.5.

subskills.name: Ranking & Retrieval Metrics (NDCG, MAP, MRR)
subskills.description: Evaluating search and recommendation models: Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG@K), Mean Average Precision (MAP@K), and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).

subskills.name: Online Model Evaluation & A/B Testing Design
subskills.description: Designing online A/B tests, sample size determination, minimum detectable effect (MDE), counterfactual evaluation, and shadow deployment metrics.

cv.signal: Designed custom metric evaluation pipelines with Stratified TimeSeriesSplit and probability calibration

linkedin.signal: Model Evaluation, Validation & Statistical Testing endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes Model Evaluation, Cross-Validation & Diagnostics Technical Assessment

junior.description: Calculates standard classification and regression metrics, generates ROC/PR curves, and analyzes learning curves for overfitting.

mid.description: Designs leak-free cross-validation splits, calibrates model probabilities (Platt/Isotonic), handles extreme imbalance (SMOTE), and tunes decision thresholds.

senior.description: Establishes online A/B testing frameworks, evaluates ranking models with NDCG/MAP, and designs statistical validation standards across company models.
